jobs.title: Vice President, Data and AI Foundations
jobs.description:
About The Role

The VP, Data and AI Foundations is an enterprise executive leadership role accountable for defining, governing, and executing SE Health's end-to-end data and AI ecosystem. This role owns the strategy, architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, and business integration of data and artificial intelligence assets across the organization.

This position provides executive oversight for enterprise data strategies, advanced analytics, machine learning/Generative AI capabilities, data architecture, information governance, business intelligence, and responsible AI ethics frameworks. The VP partners with senior executives, clinical operations, technology leadership, legal/privacy teams, and external strategic partners to transform raw enterprise data into actionable intelligence, predictive insights, automated workflows, and measurable business and clinical outcomes.

Enterprise Impact and Scope

Sets enterprise direction for data management, business intelligence, predictive/prescriptive analytics, and enterprise AI adoption strategies.
Accountable for establishing data quality, metadata management, data architecture integration, and AI ethical guardrails in alignment with organizational risk posture and regulatory standards.
Provides executive leadership for the design, scaling, and monetization/operationalization of machine learning models, Generative AI applications, and algorithmic automation.
Builds executive alignment, algorithmic trust, and scalable data-driven operating models that empower enterprise clinical, financial, and operational decision-making.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Data & AI Strategy, Investment & Governance

Enterprise Direction: Sets the enterprise vision, strategic priorities, operating model and multi-year roadmap for data and AI, aligned with SE Health’s organizational strategy, care transformation and growth objectives.
Investment Stewardship: Establishes portfolio priorities and provides executive oversight of operating and capital investments, business cases, funding recommendations and benefits realization across the data and AI portfolio.
Enterprise Standards: Establishes and approves enterprise standards for data architecture, quality, stewardship, interoperability, access, platforms and responsible AI, ensuring alignment with security, privacy, legal, clinical and regulatory requirements.
Decision Authority: Chairs or sponsors enterprise governance forums; resolves cross-enterprise priorities and trade-offs; and recommends whether initiatives should proceed, change course or stop based on strategic fit, risk, readiness and expected value.

Business Transformation, AI Adoption & Value Realization

Transformation Portfolio: Partners with executive and business leaders to identify and prioritize enterprise opportunities where data and AI can transform care delivery, client and employee experience, workforce capacity, productivity, quality, growth and financial performance.
Product and Delivery Accountability: Provides executive oversight for the end-to-end portfolio of analytics, automation and AI products, ensuring disciplined progression from discovery and experimentation through deployment, adoption, scaling and ongoing optimization.
Business Adoption: Establishes shared accountability with business owners for workflow redesign, change readiness, adoption and sustained use of data and AI capabilities across clinical and corporate functions.
Benefits Realization: Defines enterprise performance measures and holds the portfolio accountable for measurable clinical, operational, financial and strategic outcomes, including quality, safety, productivity, user adoption and return on investment.

Enterprise Risk, Privacy & Responsible AI

Risk Framework: Establishes the enterprise data and AI risk framework in partnership with Privacy, Legal & Compliance, Security, Clinical, Technology and other control functions, aligned with organizational risk appetite and regulatory obligations.
Responsible AI: Sets guardrails for ethical, transparent, explainable and equitable use of data and AI, including human oversight, bias monitoring, model validation, third-party risk and appropriate use of sensitive health information.
Executive Assurance: Provides executive visibility into material data and AI risks, control effectiveness, regulatory developments and emerging exposures, with clear recommendations and escalation pathways.
Ongoing Oversight: Ensures deployed data and AI products are monitored for safety, accuracy, security, performance, drift and unintended impacts, and initiates timely remediation where required.

Executive Partnership & Ecosystem Leadership

Executive Advisory: Serves as a trusted advisor to the Chief Digital Officer, CEO and senior leadership on enterprise data and AI strategy, investment choices, opportunities, risks and organizational readiness.
Enterprise Alignment: Builds shared ownership across clinical, operational, financial and corporate leaders and resolves competing priorities, dependencies and decision rights across the enterprise.
Commercial and Partner Strategy: Leads strategic vendor and partner relationships, including build-buy-partner decisions, commercial negotiations, performance governance, technology viability, cost optimization and responsible commercialization opportunities where appropriate.
External Leadership: Represents SE Health in relevant health-sector, technology, research and policy forums, strengthening strategic partnerships, sector influence and access to emerging capabilities.

People, Culture & Organizational Capability

Organizational Leadership: Designs and leads a high-performing, multidisciplinary Data & AI function with clear mandates, accountabilities, decision rights and performance expectations aligned to enterprise priorities.
Talent and Succession: Leads workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership development, performance management and succession planning for critical data and AI capabilities, balancing internal capacity with strategic external expertise.
Enterprise Capability: Builds data literacy, responsible AI fluency and decision-making capability across the organization so leaders and teams can use data and AI confidently, safely and effectively.
Culture and Leadership: Fosters an inclusive, collaborative and accountable culture that encourages innovation, constructive challenge, continuous learning and disciplined execution.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
MBA or Master's degree in a related discipline considered an asset.(MS/MBA in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or AI).
Relevant certifications considered an asset (e.g., Azure Data/AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Cloud Data Engineer, CIPP privacy certification, CDMP, or equivalent).
15+ years of progressive technology and data leadership experience, including senior executive accountability over enterprise data systems, business intelligence, data science, and enterprise platform delivery.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating modern data stack architectures (Data Warehouses, Lakehouses, MLOps platforms) within complex enterprise environments.
Proven track record of deploying machine learning models, predictive tools, or Generative AI solutions into core production workflows to drive business value.
Demonstrated experience managing financial planning, cloud consumption/compute budgets, investment prioritization, and portfolio governance for data and AI programs.
In-depth knowledge of health data standards, data privacy laws (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA), clinical data structures, and ethical AI/governance frameworks.
Experience establishing data governance bodies, data stewardship programs, and enterprise data quality processes.

Why Join SE Health?

At SE Health, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare while contributing to a purpose-driven organization committed to innovation, impact, and social good. You will work alongside passionate leaders who believe that sustainable healthcare requires bold thinking, meaningful partnerships, and a relentless focus on improving lives.

Competitive Total Rewards So much more than a paycheque! Enjoy comprehensive benefits, pension, flexible pay options, car-loan support, housing solutions and exclusive staff perks.
Flexibility & Belonging Thrive with hybrid work, flexible scheduling and a supportive, inclusive culture that puts people first.
Purpose & Impact Join a national social enterprise where your voice matters. Every role helps advance health, spark innovation and strengthen communities across Canada.
Growth That Meets Your Ambition Access tuition support, training and meaningful career pathways across a growing, future-focused organization.

Join us as we transform care for generations to come.

About SE Health

SE Health is a not-for-profit social enterprise advancing health with heart. With 115+ years of impact, we bring hope, happiness and exceptional care to people and communities across Canada. We lead with empathy, dignity and purpose while building a future where everyone can realize their full health and well-being potential. We’re also an inclusive, supportive workplace offering competitive compensation, strong benefits and real opportunities to grow. We’re All In Together.

The Head of Global HR Analytics and Data Office leads and oversees a team comprised of the global data office; analytics and insights; advanced analytics capabilities; reporting and visualization; and AI. Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

As Director, Data Engineering for the Public Markets and Alternate Assets (PMAA) team, you will build and publish the enterprise market data products that power investment strategies across our public markets and alternate assets businesses. Partnering closely with your business-aligned product owner, you will lead a talented team of data engineers and analysts and own the end-to-end lifecycle of PMAA data, from vendor and internal feeds through to trusted, well-documented data products used by investment teams, analytics platforms and AI agents. You will set the technical direction for a modern AWS data platform, establish the semantic and knowledge graph foundations that connect data across asset classes, and ensure every data product meets the standards of timeliness, quality, licensing compliance and control that investment decisions demand.

The Team

CPP Investments invests across public and private markets, supported by technology and data capabilities that enable informed investment decisions and long-term value creation.

Within PMAA, this role leads market data engineering and the development of enterprise data products that support investment professionals, quantitative and research teams. The team works with investment, product, architecture, technology and governance partners to deliver reliable, accessible and AI-ready market data.

Accountabilities

Define and execute the multi-year data engineering strategy and roadmap for PMAA market data products, partnering with the product owner to align priorities with investment needs and enterprise architecture standards.
Own the target-state AWS data platform architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, governance and consumption, making design and build-versus-buy decisions that balance scalability, resilience, security and cost.
Lead the development and adoption of enterprise data products across public and private markets, including pricing, reference data, corporate actions and benchmarks, with clear ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.

Strategy & Platform Leadership

Establish governance processes, performance metrics, and operational controls to ensure transparency and predictable outcomes.

Build a high-performing engineering organization focused on innovation, accountability, customer value, and technical excellence.
Drive workforce planning, succession management, capability development, and organizational growth.
Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, ownership, and engineering craftsmanship.

Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Technology Management

12+ years of progressive technology experience with significant experience leading large engineering teams and complex technology portfolios.
Proven success leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical professionals.
Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
Experience managing budgets, strategic investments, vendors, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

Data Platform Engineering

Deep expertise designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
Extensive experience with Databricks, including platform architecture, engineering, optimization, governance, and operational management.
Strong experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and large-scale distributed data processing frameworks.
Deep understanding of modern data architecture, data products, metadata management, lineage, governance, and data lifecycle management.
Experience building and scaling analytical, operational, and AI-ready data platforms.

Engineering & Architecture

Strong foundation in modern programming languages (Java, Python) and API design (REST, GraphQL).
Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native platform delivery.
Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and DevSecOps / CI/CD practices.
Proven experience building event-driven, real-time data architectures at enterprise scale.
Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Familiarity with graph or document data models (Neo4J, MongoDB).
Experience with observability tooling such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or Datadog.

Lead a team delivering master data maintenance for multiple data domains at Nutrien
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to support audits, client due diligence, and regulatory inquiries related to data and analytics
Lead data governance initiatives and change adoption efforts, influencing stakeholders and enabling consistent governance practices across domains and functions

Deep knowledge of data governance concepts, frameworks, and best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK)

You bring strong business and industry judgment. Experience in marketing, media, or sales analytics is essential, and financial services experience is a strong asset. You understand how to operate in a regulated, complex environment while still driving innovation and impact.

jobs.title: Directeur.trice technique - Capture de données de jeu / Technical Director - Game Data Capture
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

« Pour visualiser la description de poste en français, veuillez sélectionner le français dans le menu déroulant au haut de la page. »

At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content - they're places where communities build.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history - from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

As a Technical Director, you will lead the technical strategy for capturing research data from EA game sources. You will define how dedicated title streams, shared instrumentation, capture builds, and downstream data systems work together as a unified capability for Research & Engineering.

You will be responsible for driving the architecture, standards, priorities, and technical outcomes of the Game Data Capture team. You will coordinate across researchers, ML Data Engineers, title teams, central infrastructure, security, and legal partners while remaining hands-on in the most consequential technical decisions.

This is a hybrid role, working three days per week in Redwood City, Montreal, or Vancouver.

You will report to the Lead Technical Director.

Responsibilities

You will define the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for a unified cross-title game-data capture capability.
You will establish standards for supported modalities, synchronization, coordinate systems, schemas, build identity, provenance, validation, and platform performance.
You will determine which capabilities belong in the shared capture platform and which require title-specific integration.
You will prioritize title onboarding and research requests based on technical feasibility, research value, dependencies, and long-term platform leverage.
You will lead architecture and design reviews for capture SDKs, title adapters, build automation, and interfaces with central data infrastructure.
You will partner with title technical leaders to secure the expertise, access, and production safeguards needed to instrument complex game codebases.
You will define requirements for dedicated Perforce streams, automated merges, reproducible builds, CI/CD, deployment, and capture validation.
You will establish clear technical acceptance criteria for certified raw capture sessions and ensure limitations are documented.
You will identify repeated title-specific needs and guide the team toward maintainable shared solutions.
You will mentor engineers, communicate technical direction, resolve cross-team decisions, and represent Game Data Capture to research and technology leadership.

Qualifications

12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including technical leadership in AAA games, game engines, real-time simulation, or related systems
Experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple engineering teams or products
Expertise in C++ and strong working knowledge of large, multithreaded game-engine codebases
Broad experience with engine systems such as rendering, simulation, gameplay, animation, physics, audio, tools, or build pipelines
Experience integrating technology across actively developed branches, platforms, or title codebases
Experience with Perforce, complex build systems, CI/CD, and release or integration workflows
Experience translating research or product requirements into platform strategy and executable technical plans
Experience balancing rapid experimentation with security, performance, stability, maintainability, and partner-team constraints

We want to connect you with job opportunities that align with your interests, skills, and expertise. When you create an EA Careers Account and are logged into the portal, you can click “Get Recommendations” to view a curated list of job openings. These recommendations are enhanced by automated processing, including artificial intelligence, and take into account your skills and experience. However, all employment decisions are made by our hiring teams, not by automated systems.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$169,500 - $242,600 CAD
California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$193,100 - $296,500 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.description:
This is a hybrid position (4 days a week in office from one of our office locations below and 1 day a week remote).

This opportunity can be based out of either Office Location below:

Brampton location @ 1 Presidents Choice Cir, Brampton, ON L6Y 5S5 (near hwy. 407 and Mississauga Rd)
North York location @ 243 Consumers Rd, North York, ON M2J 4W8 (near hwy. 404 and hwy. 401)

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. With that growth, is a vision to be the most innovative healthcare providers in community rehabilitation, workplace health and wellness and medical assessment services. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

About the role:

As a senior technology and product leader, you will own the strategy, investment portfolio, architecture alignment and evolution of Lifemark’s Product & Platform ecosystem. You will translate business strategy into a multi-year product and platform roadmap that connects referral management, clinical operations, affiliate and customer partners, patients, and enterprise capabilities across Lifemark’s national care network.

The role is accountable for maximizing the value of Lifemark’s proprietary and third-party platforms, and integrated partner capabilities. You will lead the Product Management organization and work closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Data & Analytics, Security and business leaders to ensure the ecosystem evolves as an integrated, modular platform rather than a collection of independently managed systems.

A key mandate is to establish a modular enterprise architecture that enables Lifemark to reuse common capabilities across products and businesses, integrate acquisitions more efficiently, and selectively build, buy or partner for new functionality. This includes defining clear platform boundaries, shared services, APIs, integration patterns, enterprise data models and reusable components that allow experiences and capabilities to evolve without requiring replacement of core systems.

Success will be measured through improved patient access, clinician productivity, clinic operational efficiency, referral performance, acquisition scalability, technology reuse and return on technology investment.

Key Responsibilities:

Product & Platform Strategy: Own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Lifemark’s integrated Product & Platform ecosystem, aligned to enterprise growth, clinical and operational priorities.
Enterprise Architecture & Platform Evolution: Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering to define the target-state architecture for the ecosystem, including platform boundaries, shared services, APIs, integration patterns, dataflowsand technology standards.
Modular Capability Strategy: Establish a modular approach to product development, identifying common capabilities that can be developed once and reused proprietary platforms, acquisition businesses and future platforms. Examples may include scheduling, identity and access, communications, billing, payments, document management, reporting, patient engagement and workflow services.
Build, Buy, Partner & Integrate: Determine where Lifemark should build proprietary capabilities, leverage third-party solutions, establish strategic partnerships or integrate existing enterprise platforms while preserving control of strategically important systems and data.
Portfolio & Investment Management: Prioritize investments across products, platforms and shared capabilities based on business value, strategic fit, architectural alignment, capacity, risk and ROI.
High-Performing Product Organization: Build, lead and develop Product Managers, Business Solution Managers and Business Systems Analysts and establish consistent product-management disciplines across the organization.
Business Outcomes: Establish measurable product outcomes and ensure roadmap investments deliver improvements in clinician productivity, patient experience, referral performance, operational efficiency and network scalability.
Product Discovery & Customer Insight: Establish continuous feedback loops with end users and enterprise stakeholders; use research, analytics and experimentation to inform priorities.
Cross-Product Experience & Interoperability: Ensure workflows operate seamlessly across systems, reducing duplicate capabilities, manual hand-offs and fragmented user experiences.
Enterprise Data & Analytics: Partner with Data & Analytics and Architecture to ensure products contribute to a common enterprise data foundation that enables network-wide operational visibility, advancedanalyticsand future AI capabilities.
Delivery Partnership: Partner with Engineering and Architecture leaders to translate product strategy into executable plans while balancing modernization, new capabilities, technical debt, platform health and delivery capacity.
AI & Automation: Identify, prioritize and scale AI-enabled and automated capabilities that deliver measurable improvements in clinical workflows, operational efficiency and decision-making.
Vendor & Strategic Partnerships: Own product-level strategy and value realization for third-party technology partners, ensuring vendor roadmaps and architectures align with Lifemark’s target-state ecosystem.
Financial Management: Own product and platform budgets, business cases, investment approvals and benefit realization.
Risk, Privacy & Compliance: Ensure products, integrations and shared platform capabilities meet healthcare privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory and enterprise risk requirements.
Executive Communication & Governance: Provide senior leadership with clear visibility into portfolio priorities, architectural decisions, investment trade-offs, dependencies and business outcomes.

What we're looking for:

10+ years of progressive experience across digital product,technologyor platform leadership, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary product organizations.
Demonstrated experience developing product and platform strategies across complex, interconnected technology ecosystems.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture concepts, modular platform design, APIs, shared services, integrationpatternsand reusable capabilities.
Experience partnering closely with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering teams to translate business strategy into scalable technology platforms.
Experience making build, buy,partnerand integrate decisions across proprietary and third-party platforms.
Experience with Practice Management Systems, Electronic Medical Records or healthcare technology ecosystems is an asset, including scheduling, clinical documentation,billingand patient engagement.
Demonstrated ability to apply and scale AI/ML and automation to improve business and clinical outcomes.
Strong financial and portfolio-management skills, including business cases, investmentprioritizationand benefit realization.
Excellent executive stakeholder communication, outcome-based roadmapping , organizational design and talent development.

Our Perks:

Eligible to earn an annual Short-Term-Incentive Plan
Have access to a yearly education re-imbursement fund
Receive 30% discount from Shopper Drug Mart purchases
Contribute to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) with employer matching percentage
Have paid vacation days as well as wellness days
Have a choice to enroll in our Health & Dental Flex Life Benefits (or in lieu contribute to your RRSPs)
Annual Bonus Incentive
Access to employee assistance program
On-site gym, Basketball & Volleyball courts, Ice Rink, Groceries delivered to work via PC Express, Dry-Cleaning services (1 Presidents Choice Circle Office)

Inclusion

Lifemark welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Lifemark promotes equal employment opportunities for all job applicants, including those self-identifying as a member of the following groups: Indigenous peoples, Newcomers to Canada, and Visible minorities.

to play a critical leadership role in shaping the future of the business.

This position offers a unique opportunity to influence enterprise-wide strategy, operational effectiveness, digital transformation, cybersecurity, AI adoption, and business technology initiatives. Reporting to executive leadership, you will serve as the bridge between business operations and technology, ensuring solutions support organizational growth, efficiency, innovation, and exceptional customer experiences.

This role is ideal for a collaborative leader who combines strong business acumen with technology expertise and thrives in an environment where relationship building, coaching, and cross-functional leadership are essential.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Business Transformation

Partner with executive leadership to align technology and operational initiatives with business goals.
Drive enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and business performance.
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and Microsoft Copilot, to enhance productivity and decision-making.

Technology & Business Solutions

Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that create measurable business value.

Cybersecurity, Risk & Governance

Ensure technology solutions meet regulatory, compliance, security, and risk management requirements.

Project Management & Operational Excellence

Drive continuous improvement initiatives across departments and functional areas.

jobs.description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Data Platform will lead Zynga's centralized data platform and product strategy, managing one of the largest data footprints in the gaming industry—billions of daily gameplay events flowing through a cloud-native stack spanning real-time ingestion, a petabyte-scale warehouse, experimentation, and a self-serve metrics and AI platform. Operating with high autonomy and direct executive sponsorship, you will act as a pathfinder: empowering our global studios to extract maximum value from central data and transforming the group to an AI-first way of working. This highly visible role is based in Toronto and partners closely with studio leaders, central teams, and executives across Zynga's global labels. Relocation support is available.

What You'll Do

Craft data product strategy: Define, roadmap, and execute the product strategy for Zynga's centralized data products, translating vision into initiatives that empower global studios.
Drive AI adoption: Champion an AI-first approach, pushing teams to innovate and leverage clean, trusted data for advanced AI/ML capabilities.
Lead a global team: Manage, mentor, and grow a diverse team of ~60 across North America, Israel, and India—including Directors, Senior Managers, and non-engineering functions such as Product and Program Management.
Oversee data governance: Establish robust data compliance and governance frameworks for a massive, global data footprint.
Navigate and execute: Guide the team through organizational change while maintaining global alignment and building effective processes and outcomes.

What You Bring

Experience: 15+ years in data or software engineering, including 8+ years leading and scaling engineering organizations, with experience managing managers (Directors and Senior Managers).
Executive leadership: A track record leading global, matrixed teams of tenured leaders, with strong executive presence across studios, labels, and executive stakeholders.
Technical pedigree: A deep engineering background—including hands-on IC experience earlier in your career—with the depth to make architectural calls across a modern cloud data stack: cloud data warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery), streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Spark), orchestration and transformation (Airflow, dbt), and lakehouse/ML platforms (Databricks, SageMaker). Highly technical product leaders on the data side are also encouraged to apply.
AI/ML expertise: A proven, hands-on track record of shipping AI/ML systems to production—feature/training pipelines, deployment, and monitoring. Familiarity with modern LLM and agentic patterns (RAG, semantic layers, MCP-style tooling) is a strong need. This is a critical, non-negotiable requirement.
Platform depth: Demonstrated ownership of large-scale, cloud-native data platforms on AWS—modeling, batch and streaming pipelines, cost/performance optimization, reliability (SLOs, observability), and data quality at scale.
Semantic layer & governance: Experience scaling semantic/metrics layers and self-serve analytics (dbt, metrics stores, Tableau/Lightdash) and familiarity with experimentation platforms and data privacy/compliance frameworks.
Cross-functional leadership: Comfort managing non-engineering functions (Product and Production) and translating technical concepts into clear business value for executives and non-engineers.

Previous leadership experience within the gaming industry. Candidates from top-tier tech, consumer tech, or large-scale enterprise tech are also highly encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a member of CIBC’s AI, Data and Analytics team, the Senior Director – Decision Science will lead the Insurance Decision Science team and be responsible for developing and executing strategic initiatives across a range of CIBC Insurance products and projects. This is a senior technical leadership role that combines actuarial, statistical, data science and AI enablement capabilities. The role naturally involves a comprehensive understanding of Creditor (Bank Authorized) and Non-Authorized insurance products. You’ll exercise a high degree of independent judgement, setting the technical direction and standards for decision science activities that support pricing, profitability, growth, forecasting, portfolio performance and strategic decision making. You will develop and maintain trusted relationships across the Insurance business, larger Retail Banking organization and the technology and data science communities. In addition, you’ll translate sophisticated analysis of complex business information into clear recommendations for executives and business leaders, while providing independent challenge to assumptions, forecasts and proposed courses of action. You’ll drive innovation across areas of your responsibility and apply expert interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Strategy and Planning – Contribute to long-term strategy for the business in collaboration with insurance product and business leaders. Translate actuarial and advanced analytics into decisions on pricing, profitability, growth, forecasting and portfolio performance; identify opportunities, develop strategic proposals and independently challenge key assumptions and targets. Collaborate with internal partners to oversee, communicate and align business plans and ensure delivery on strategy and intended business outcomes.
Technical Skills - Set and maintain standards for actuarial, statistical, data science and AI-enabled methods, models, tools and controls. Apply quantitative methods to identify, assess and validate the drivers of profitability, growth, market share, portfolio performance and risk exposure, and synthesize complex analysis to influence business decisions and outcomes. Establish forward-looking performance measurement, forecasting, product analysis and decision-support capabilities that enable timely action, rather than reporting results alone.
People Management - Own the team’s capability and talent strategy, including workforce planning, succession, hiring, development, coaching and deployment of actuarial and analytics talent against business priorities. Build differentiated technical capabilities, establish clear role and proficiency standards, and create development pathways that strengthen the team over time. Manage capacity to ensure initiatives are appropriately staffed, identify capability gaps and remove obstacles to performance. Create a positive work environment and role model by championing CIBC’s mission, vision and values. Comply with policies, standards, guidelines and controls by applying them fairly and consistently so employees understand what to expect.

Who You Are

You are a senior actuarial and analytics leader with strong quantitative knowledge and relevant industry experience. You are an actuary, and hold an advanced degree an actuarial, data science, analytics or related technical field, or equivalent experience, and bring senior-level experience in insurance.
You have a high degree of Insurance product knowledge and understand the regulatory landscape. You have expert knowledge of insurance products (both authorized and non-authorized), banking and insurance frameworks, and the risk and compliance considerations that shape product decisions.
You can demonstrate extensive experience in product management, strategic planning, and project management sufficient to identify, develop, and implement approved initiatives. You have strong analytical, problem-solving skills, excellent communication and presentation skills sufficient to prepare and present material to an executive audience.
You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You're confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.
You’re an effective leader and collaborator. You build strong relationships across teams, use sound judgment, manage multiple priorities effectively and help create an environment where people can do their best work. You are a technical leader, not a distant administrator. You remain intellectually engaged in the methods, systems, and decisions that determine whether the work succeeds.
You act like an owner. You thrive when you're empowered to take the lead, go above and beyond, and deliver results.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

What we do every day to be our very best

Every day at Securian Canada means a day spent helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. We’re agile and innovative, and we aren't afraid to challenge and create, or bring diverse perspectives to our work.

As our Director, Analytics & Insights

that empowers leaders with trusted insights, scalable analytics products, modern business intelligence, and practical AI-enabled solutions
.

Reporting to the AVP, Data Solutions, you'll lead a multidisciplinary team
responsible for Analytics & Insights, Business Intelligence, and Analytics Engineering. Working across business and technology teams, you'll help create a shared understanding of customers, products, markets, financial performance, and organizational priorities, enabling smarter decisions at every level of the organization.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on leadership
. You'll influence enterprise priorities
, guide complex analytical initiatives, challenge assumptions, and help leaders translate insights into action.

The leader we're looking for combines strong business judgment with technical depth
. You start with the decision that needs to be made, not the tool that will be used. You understand that data and analytics are strategic business assets
and know how to balance immediate business needs with scalable enterprise solutions. You're pragmatic, collaborative, governance-minded, and skilled at translating complex analytical concepts into compelling business narratives that drive action.

Most importantly, you're passionate about building high-performing teams
, developing talent
, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where people can do their best work while making a meaningful impact
.

At Securian Canada, analytics is about more than understanding what happened. It's about helping people make better decisions that support our mission of helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. You'll join a team of talented professionals who are committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that make a real difference across our business.

The base salary range for this position is between $130,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Details of our additional benefits are outlined below. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Only one position is available. However, it may be based in multiple locations: Toronto (ON), or Waterloo (ON), or Montreal (QC).

What You Will Do

Lead Enterprise Analytics Strategy & Decision Support

Define and execute an analytics and insights roadmap aligned with enterprise, market, customer, and partner priorities.
Transform strategic business questions into actionable analytical opportunities, KPI frameworks, data requirements, and decision-support solutions.
Deliver meaningful insights into business performance, customer behaviour, claims experience, product results, portfolio trends, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks.

Guide innovative solutions from ideation through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and long-term success.

Lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals across analytics, insights, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics engineering.
Foster a culture focused on analytical excellence, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and business partnership.
Provide guidance on analytical problem solving, data-product design, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
Help team members grow beyond traditional reporting by strengthening skills in problem framing, root-cause analysis, insight generation, and strategic recommendations.
Create an environment where innovation, curiosity, and measurable business outcomes are valued and celebrated.

Build Strong Partnerships Across the Organization

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping connect business priorities to data-driven solutions.
Build strong relationships across Data Solutions, Technology, Finance, Operations, and business teams.
Influence decision-making by bringing clarity, insight, and strategic perspective to complex challenges.
Champion a data-informed culture that increases confidence, consistency, and trust in organizational decision-making.

What You Will Bring

University degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data science, decision support, or related fields, including leadership responsibilities.
Demonstrated success building, transforming, or significantly advancing enterprise analytics capabilities within a complex organization.
Strong experience translating ambiguous business challenges into actionable analytical solutions, meaningful insights, and measurable outcomes.
Deep expertise in SQL, Python, analytical data modeling, business intelligence platforms, and modern cloud data environments.
Experience developing scalable analytical datasets, curated data products, KPI frameworks, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions.
Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, from source systems and data engineering through analytics delivery and business consumption.
Experience applying advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, or AI-enabled solutions to business challenges.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders while effectively leading highly technical teams.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience building, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
Experience within insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is considered an asset.
Experience with cloud data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, and modern self-service BI platforms.
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, model governance, data quality, lineage, explainability, and operational controls.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and inspire action through data.
A strategic and product-oriented mindset focused on delivering sustainable, scalable solutions that create long-term business value.

Why join?

When you’re a part of Securian Canada, you’re a member of an agile and innovative, high-performing, bright-thinking, make-things-happen culture – so that together, we can discover the art of possible.

BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full-service North American-based financial services provider, with over 2,700 professionals in 30 locations around the world, including 20 offices in North America, offering corporate, institutional and government clients access to a complete range of investment and corporate banking products and services. BMO Capital Markets is a member of BMO Financial Group (NYSE, TSX: BMO), one of the largest diversified financial services providers in North America with US$1.0 trillion total assets and approximately 54,000 employees as of January 31, 2025.

What is the opportunity?

The Data Cognition Team (DCT) is BMO Capital Markets’ AI engineering and enablement team, with nearly a decade of experience building and deploying AI solutions in complex, regulated financial services environments.

As Vice President, AI Strategy & Product Management, you will operate at the intersection of business strategy, product management, and AI. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, delivery, and adoption of high-value AI and data products, working closely with front-office users, senior leaders, engineers, data scientists, UX, risk, and compliance partners.

The successful candidate will bring the judgment, influence, and hands-on product leadership required to scale trusted AI and data products and capabilities in a highly regulated Capital Markets environment.

What will you do?

Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, investment priorities, and business outcomes for one or more AI-enabled products or capabilities supporting Capital Markets users and workflows.
Develop a deep understanding of front-office and business needs; translate strategic pain points into clear product opportunities.
Lead product discovery, experimentation, and investment decisions, including prototypes, proofs of concept, and minimum viable products, to validate assumptions before scaling.
Align senior business, technology, data, and control-function stakeholders around product priorities, trade-offs, risks, and expected outcomes.
Establish product goals and success measures, monitor adoption and performance, and use quantitative and qualitative insights to improve products and demonstrate business impact.
Present product recommendations, performance, risks, and strategic choices to senior leadership and governance forums.
Apply Responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, model risk, and regulatory considerations throughout the product lifecycle in partnership with control functions.

What do you need to succeed?

Bachelor’s degree in a related field; an advanced degree or relevant professional designation is an asset.
6+ years of relevant experience in product management, strategy, digital transformation, or technology delivery, ideally within Capital Markets or financial services; familiarity with AI and data product management is an asset.
Ability to understand complex Capital Markets workflows and translate between business users and technical teams; direct experience with sales, trading, research, banking, or client-coverage workflows is an asset.
Hands-on familiarity with AI and LLM-enabled products, including retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, and production deployment considerations.
Strong written and verbal communication, analytical judgment, structured problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.

jobs.title: VP, Digital
jobs.description:
The Vice President, Digital runs the commercial operation of the digital channel, turning merchandising, marketing and loyalty offers into activated onsite experiences that make the eCommerce plan achievable.

Reporting to the SVP, Digital & Loyalty, accountability spans onsite execution end to end: the merchandising experience, digital assortment and promo activation, online assortment expansion (2P ownership), product content health, and the product data that helps customers discover products, build intent to purchase, and ultimately convert. The mandate is delivered in close partnership with the COO organization. As the primary digital partner to the Banner Presidents and merchandising teams, the VP translates banner and category plans into onsite execution.

The position also owns how customers find Canadian Tire in a changing discovery landscape. As search shifts from traditional engines to answer engines, generative surfaces and agentic shopping assistants, this role leads the SEO, AEO and GEO agenda — from early experimentation to scaled, repeatable practice. The VP is a key stakeholder in the True North eCommerce Accelerate strategy, shaping business requirements that Digital Product teams can translate into new capabilities across the digital commerce ecosystem, including Digital Harmonization, 2P and Digital Experience Drivers.

What You'll Do

Digital Merchandising

Own the onsite merchandising experience across homepage, category pages, navigation and onsite search relevance.
Own digital assortment presentation and promo execution onsite, aligned to banner, category and enterprise promo plans.
Ensure marketing, merchandising and loyalty offers are activated consistently across the websites and the CTR app.
Surface the right products earlier in the shopping journey, converting discovery into considered intent to purchase.
Partner with Pricing & Promo and Brand & Marketing so onsite execution reflects the enterprise promotional calendar and price architecture.
Serve as the senior digital partner to Banner Presidents and category teams, translating their plans into a clear onsite execution plan with visible trade-offs where capacity is constrained.

Digital Analytics & Activation

Act as the key owner driving the agentic commerce ambition forward — defining how CTC's assortment, content and offers are surfaced to AI shopping assistants and agent-mediated journeys.
Lead the AEO and GEO agenda alongside SEO, treating traditional and AI-driven discovery as one connected practice.
Own onsite performance analytics, including KPI definition, competitive benchmarking and the digital measurement fact base used in commercial decisions.
Build the measurement approach for AI-driven discovery — visibility, citation, referral quality and downstream intent to purchase — and use it to steer investment.
Run the digital activation and experimentation practice, converting test wins into standing site practice rather than one-off lifts.
Own the digital performance management rhythm: KPI reporting, performance reviews and early escalation of risks to the outlook.
Partner with IT on the technical integrations required for search, LLM and agentic discoverability.

Digital Content Operations

Own onsite content health across copy, imagery and specification accuracy, at the quality standard the banners expect.
Own content grooming and meta tagging so customers can discover our products across search, generative and agentic surfaces.
Ensure product content answers the questions that drive purchase decisions, building customer confidence and intent at the point of discovery.
Run vendor product data onboarding, data quality and bilingual compliance, scaling throughput as assortment expands.
Set the structured data and content standards that allow customers — and the assistants acting for them — to discover our products and understand why to choose them.

Product Content Capabilities

Own the content platform agenda across Product 2.0 including PIM, PCM and DAM, defining the operational requirements that the roadmap must satisfy.
Drive product process automation and AI-assisted rules that scale onboarding without scaling headcount.
Lead a team of product managers and manage IT delivery of new capability and ongoing support.
Partner with Digital Product on roadmap sequencing so capability lands against real category and banner plans.

Online Assortment (2P)

Serve as the True North 2P initiative lead, accountable for the initiative's direction, milestones and reported outcomes.
Build the 2P assortment expansion agenda — onboarding, content readiness and onsite presentation at scale.
Connect 2P growth to the broader discoverability agenda so expanded assortment is surfaced to customers and AI-driven discovery alike.
Represent 2P progress, risks and trade-offs in True North governance and enterprise forums.

Team & Leadership

Lead a multi-disciplinary team spanning digital merchandising, analytics and activation, content operations and content management products.
Build capability and bench strength across the function, with clear accountability at the AVP level and a deliberate approach to vacancy and succession risk.
Set a performance culture grounded in evidence, speed and commercial ownership.

What You Bring

Senior leadership experience in eCommerce, digital commerce or omni-channel retail, with the ability to operate as a peer to senior commercial, banner and merchandising leaders.
A proven record of delivering commercial results through digital execution, onsite activation and measurable customer experience improvements in a large, multi-banner retail environment.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Data Governance
jobs.description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description

The Director, Enterprise Data Governance is accountable for defining and governing the enterprise data QuadReal relies on, anchored in DAMA-DMBOK, covering data definitions, ownership, quality, and observability. This makes QuadReal's data reliable enough to be governed, measured, and controlled, reducing the risk that decisions, reporting, and controls rest on data that can't be trusted. The role reports to the VP, Risk & Integrated Assurance and turns the VP's enterprise-wide mandate into one accountable operating model focused on risk mitigation through data governance lens.

Success is measured by the risk it mitigates: data issues caught before they become decisions made on incorrect information, ownership gaps closed before they become accountability gaps. Holding up under audit is one key aspect of that risk mitigation but not the goal in itself.

The Director also supports the VP's overall view of QuadReal's risk and control environment and represents Data Governance in Risk & Integrated Assurance reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Governance
Define QuadReal’s enterprise data definitions, classifications, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs), anchored in DAMA-DMBOK.
Own the data ownership and accountability model: name Data Owners, Stewards, and Custodians, and hold them accountable through a defined sign-off cadence.
Deliver the enterprise business glossary under a tiered governance model, and maintain metadata management, lineage standards, and dbt metadata synchronization across the platform.
Set data quality thresholds and Trusted Layer certification criteria, and hold data observability (freshness, pipeline health, trust scores) to the same standard as financial controls.
Align controls as gates across the data delivery lifecycle (ingestion, definition, build, use, and govern), so a control fires wherever data advances and nothing reaches a certified output without passing.
Build data governance capability across the business through training and playbooks, rather than keeping expertise centralized.
Integration and Decision Authority
Act as the link between Business Controls and Data Governance called for in the integrated operating model: define control standards and evidence expectations alongside data definitions, and build controls into new systems and initiatives from the start.
Where control standards and data definitions conflict, collaborate with relevant stakeholders including, ED&A, Business Owners and Business Controls to resolve these inconsistencies. Work with ED&A / Technology and the Data Platform team so controls and governance are proactively built into the toolchain (Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Airflow, Power BI, Purview, Entra ID, Quadrant) by design.
Represent Data Governance in Risk & Integrated Assurance meetings and support Audit Committee reporting.
Team Leadership
Lead and develop direct report(s) and set clear deliverables and cadence for them..
Build team capability in data analytics, AI literacy, and integrated systems controls as the role grows, and build bench strength to move the environment from project to sustained run-state without single points of failure.
Build a “one team” culture between Business Controls and Data Governance that removes duplicate work and closes the gaps that used to sit between the two groups.

What Success Looks Like

Controls operating as gates, each with a named owner and re-performable evidence.
Audit outcomes: clean walkthroughs, deficiencies remediated, and SOC scope defensible.
Glossary and standards adopted, so certified numbers are built on agreed definitions.
Governance measured by delivery: trusted, in-use data products standing behind reported figures.
Direct reports delivering to plan, with growing capability and bench strength.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Risk Management, Data Management, Computer Science, or a related discipline; Master is an asset.
8+ years of progressive experience across data governance, risk management, or audit, including at least 2 years leading people, and demonstrable end-to-end delivery of a control or governance environment.
Working knowledge of ICFR, SOC 1 / ISAE 3402, COSO 2013, ITGCs, and DAMA-DMBOK; CPA, CIA, CISA, or CDMP an asset. Familiarity with DCAM / CDMC and data contracts an asset.

Lead the transformation of one of CGI Canada's largest Financial Services businesses. The Opportunity:

Toronto Financial Services is entering its next phase of growth.

As AI reshapes the industry and client expectations evolve, Artificial Intelligence is transforming how clients operate. Global Capability Centres are reshaping delivery models. This role exists to build the future. Your future duties and responsibilities

Position Business Consulting as a primary driver of transformational engagements. Increase consulting-led opportunities that create long-term strategic partnerships and expand CGI's influence within client organizations.

Solve problems early with accountability and ownership.

Move at the Speed of the Opportunity

Make timely decisions. Clients will not wait.

Bring Ideas Before They're Asked For

Shape the agenda rather than reacting to it.

Make AI Non-Negotiable

Ensure AI fluency across the leadership team and the business.

Maintain quality, delivery excellence, and client trust under all circumstances.

Say the Hard Thing Early

Lead with transparency and clarity to build stronger businesses.

Prove It With Numbers

Measure success through outcomes and business impact.

Make Noise About What Works

Recognize and share success so best practices can be adopted across the business.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

What You've Done Before

Built or scaled a consulting, technology, or managed services business with full P&L accountability, growing revenue and margin together.
Driven organic growth and new client acquisition across multiple service lines, not just one.
Led executive-level client relationships and secured large, strategic engagements, including opportunities developed before formal procurement.

Built leadership teams, succession plans, and market visibility through analyst relations, media engagement, and industry recognition.

Success Looks Like

Three years from now:

Revenue has outpaced the market.
Business Consulting represents a larger share of the business.
AI-enabled services generate meaningful revenue.
Contribution margins have improved.
Clients engage CGI earlier and more strategically.

jobs.description:
Position:
Vice President – Governance & Reporting, Internal Audit
Location:
Montreal

About Us

The Maples Group is a global leader in financial services, trusted by many of the world’s largest hedge fund managers, private equity firms, and international corporations.
Our side-by-side financial and legal teams consistently deliver award-winning services to a global client base, offering unrivalled learning and career opportunities to our 2,500 colleagues worldwide. With 18 locations across the Americas, Asia, Europe and the Middle East, our international presence offers a unique springboard for career development and cross- cultural immersion.

What’s it like to work here?

We are driven to excel, and collaboration is key to our continued success. We can go further for our clients because we go further for each other too. We are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal of opportunity as we attract, retain and develop world-class talent. Our inclusive culture creates an environment where people can be themselves at work while doing their best work. No matter where you work in the Maples Group, you will be part of a global team.

The Opportunity

The Maples Group is seeking a Vice President – Governance & Reporting to join our Internal Audit team in Montreal. This is newly created leadership role is responsible for designing, executing and continuously enhancing the governance, reporting and quality-assurance framework for our global Internal Audit function. Acting as a key architect of our third line of defence, the successful candidate will ensure that Internal Audit delivers clear, timely and data-driven insight to the Audit Committees and key stakeholders, while aligning with the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) global Internal Audit Standards.

Consistently recognised as one of Montreal’s Top Employers, the Maples Group established our operations in the central downtown area in 2009. Our Montreal office exemplifies our culturally rich and entrepreneurial organisation, with over 300 colleagues from 50 countries collaborating to deliver best-in-class solutions to clients worldwide.

Reporting directly to the Senior Vice-President, you will:

Own the end-to-end Internal Audit governance calendar, including timely preparation and delivery of reporting packs for audit meetings
Produce concise, visually engaging dashboards on audit plan delivery, thematic issues, outstanding audit findings, emerging risks and quality metrics for senior stakeholders and the Audit Committees
Design, implement and maintain a comprehensive Quality Assurance and Improvement Programme (QAIP) in line with the IIA Standards and local regulatory requirements
Govern the creation, periodic review and formal approval of audit methodology (IA Charter, Internal Audit Procedures Manual, templates and guidance notes) ensuring timely updates for regulatory and professional-standards changes
Operate the escalation framework for delays, scope changes and impediments, ensuring early and transparent communication
Track and report on audit findings, actions and remediation progress
Manage the automation agenda for Internal Audit, including digitisation of audit processes and report templates, exploration of automation technologies, and enhancement of risk-rating methodologies through data analytics and predictive indicators
Serve as Internal Audit’s primary liaison on governance and quality matters with senior management, risk and compliance heads, and external auditors; present complex technical concepts in a clear, business-oriented manner tailored to diverse audiences

Whilst governance and reporting are the primary functions of this role, the candidate may be requested to assist with or conduct audit engagements.

What You Bring

In addition to indisputably high ethical standards and autonomy, the ideal candidate possesses the following:
A minimum of 5 years’ experience in internal audit within financial services or a similarly regulated environment
Proven expertise in designing and operating an Internal Audit quality-assurance framework; prior responsibility for a QAIP or equivalent is strongly preferred
Strong knowledge of the IIA Standards and associated guidance
Demonstrated success in governance reporting to boards of directors, Audit Committees and regulators, with superior written and verbal communication skills

Key skills and qualifications for this role are as follows:

Attention to detail, professionalism and a team first mentality
Experience with data-analytics and automation tools; ability to translate technology opportunities into practical efficiency gains
Strong understanding of risk and control assessment techniques, risk taxonomies and audit-universe construction
Highly organised self-starter, capable of working independently, managing multiple priorities and influencing without direct authority
Excellent time management, organisational, prioritisation and communication skills (fluent written and oral English)

Benefits & Rewards

The most enduring professional relationships are reciprocal relationships. The Maples Group prioritises employee health and wellbeing. We offer a range of benefits, including:

Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental and optical)
Competitive vacation packages
Educational assistance and professional development programs
Savings or pension plan
Life insurance
Travel insurance
Global mental wellness program
Social events

Disclaimer:
All personal information collected during the application process will be used for recruitment-related purposes only. Please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice at maples.com/privacy for details on how we handle personal information relating to job applicants.

“Please note that it is the Maples Group standard policy to undertake various background screening checks on all applicants to whom a conditional job offer is made. Except for roles based in the Republic of Ireland, the background checks will include criminal records checks when a conditional job offer is made. If you have a criminal record, it does not mean that your job offer will be automatically withdrawn. The Maples Group will make all job offer decisions on a case-by-case basis and will take a number of factors into account, such as the role that you are applying for and the nature and circumstances of the past offence. You will have the opportunity to discuss the matter with us before a decision is made. Further details will be provided at the time any conditional job offer is made.”

Vice-président – Gouvernance et production de rapports, Audit interne

Montréal

À propos de nous

Le Groupe Maples est un leader mondial des services financiers auquel font confiance de nombreux gestionnaires de fonds de couverture, sociétés de capital-investissement et entreprises internationales parmi les plus importants au monde.
Nos équipes financières et juridiques, qui travaillent côte à côte, fournissent constamment des services primés à une clientèle mondiale, offrant ainsi des possibilités d’apprentissage et de carrière inégalées à nos 2 500 collègues dans le monde. L’occasion

accompli pour se joindre à notre équipe au sein de notre activité de services financiers à Montréal.

Vos principales responsabilités comprennent :
